area.description: Neighbourhood/area detected from venue+address; Shenzhen = not detected

categories.description: [major category, subcategory] from the source breadcrumb, e.g. ["Shows & Nightlife", "Indie"]

district.description: Chinese administrative district, e.g. 南山区 / 福田区; null when unknown

end.description: End of the next occurrence, ISO 8601 Asia/Shanghai (+08:00)

fee.description: "Free", "¥118" or "¥118–¥208"; null when the source gives no usable price

languages.description: inLanguage values from the source, e.g. ["zh", "english"]

occurrences_count.description: Total occurrences of this event listed on the source page

schema_type.description: schema.org @type on the source page, e.g. MusicEvent / SocialEvent / Festival

start.description: Start of the next occurrence, ISO 8601 Asia/Shanghai (+08:00)

summary_tw.description: Traditional Chinese summary, generated from summary_zh with OpenCC (s2tw) by tools/gen_tw.py; null when summary_zh is null

summary_zh.description: Chinese (Simplified) summary, translated from summary by the maintainer and merged from summary-zh.json; null when not yet translated

title_tw.description: Traditional Chinese event name, generated from title_zh with OpenCC (s2tw) by tools/gen_tw.py; null when title_zh is null

title_zh.description: Chinese event name, when the source provides one

url.description: Original event page on szmeetups.com — always link back here

updated_at.description: Last scrape time, Asia/Shanghai ISO 8601 with +08:00, e.g. 2026-10-31T10:10:07+08:00
